title: Question 9
stem: Ultrasound is used to produce diagnostic information about internal body structures.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how ultrasound waves are detected.

markscheme_points.text: (ultrasound) wave causes shape change / vibrations (of crystal)
shape change / vibrations causes e.m.f. (which is detected)

hints: Hint 1: Focus on the physical mechanism in medical imaging physics that causes this behavior.
Hint 2: Rearrange the algebraic equation to isolate the target variable before substituting numerical values.
Hint 3: Ensure all quantities are expressed in standard SI base units and verify your intermediate arithmetic before writing the final result to 2 or 3 significant figures.
parts.proper_answer: piezo-electric crystal; (ultrasound) wave causes shape change / vibrations (of crystal); shape change / vibrations causes e.m.f. (which is detected)
walkthrough:
